 PTI 
 Advertisement The sports news portal 1xBat Sporting Lines has signed a partnership agreement with the International League T20 (ILT20) and will remain its Premier Partner for a second consecutive season.
 New Delhi [India], November 20: The ILT20 is a professional Twenty20 cricket league based in the UAE and organised with support from the Emirates Cricket Board. The 2026 International League T20 season will run from 21 November to 20 December 2026, with 34 matches in total. Six teams are taking part in the tournament: Abu Dhabi Knight Riders, Desert Vipers, MI Emirates, Dubai Capitals, Gulf Giants and Sharjah Warriorz.
 The league allows supporters worldwide to follow international cricket stars in the short, fast-paced T20 format. The fifth season will feature familiar names including Romario Shepherd, Nicholas Pooran, Babar Azam, Fakhar Zaman, Rashid Khan, Moeen Ali, Ibrahim Zadran, Liam Livingstone and many others. The ambassadors for ILT20 2026 will be fast-bowling legends Brett Lee and Shoaib Akhtar, who are hugely popular amongst cricket fans.
 “We are delighted to continue our partnership with 1xBat for the new ILT20 season. Long-term relationships with partners who share our enthusiasm for cricket are vital for the league’s continued development. We are looking forward to another thrilling season and hope to work together to make the competition more accessible to cricket fans,” said an International League T20 representative.
 In the UAE, India and Pakistan, the ILT20’s key markets, matches will be broadcast across several television and digital platforms. Coverage will also be available in more than 12 countries, including Canada, Sri Lanka and nations in Southeast Asia and the MENA region.
 Advertisement 
 In its fourth season, the ILT20 attracted 397 million unique viewers across television and OTT platforms, whilst its digital content generated over 2.5 billion video views. The first figure was 7.49 per cent higher than in the previous season, indicating the league’s strong media appeal and potential for further audience growth.
 “The ILT20 is the world’s second-most-watched T20 cricket league, and for the second year running, we are delighted to be part of this event that brings together a vast international audience of cricket fans. This partnership reflects our genuine passion, our commitment to supporting cricket and our desire to bring fans closer to the game they love,” said a 1xBat representative.
 Advertisement 
 1xBat’s partnership with the ILT20 combines the brand’s presence in television broadcasts with stadium branding, digital communications and integration into tournament activities. The 1xBat logo will feature on stadium advertising screens during matches, at post-match interviews and press conferences, on match awards, on the ILT20 website and on social media. This diverse and comprehensive approach maximises opportunities for the brand to connect with fans throughout the season.
 1xBat Sporting Lines is developing a sports media platform and supporting the growth of cricket through sponsorship of teams and tournaments at an international level. Working with ILT20 is another step in this direction.
 Advertisement 
 Follow the latest news and events from the tournament on the official 1xBat Sporting Lines and ILT20 channels.
 Advertisement 
 About 1xBat Sporting Lines
 1xBat Sporting Lines is an online news platform where you can find the most important sports news. 1xBat readers receive daily updates on cricket, kabaddi, football and other sports. Visitors can view team rankings and find predictions for sporting events.
 In 2026, the brand became a Platinum Sponsor of India’s tour of Sri Lanka and an Official Partner of the 2026 World Championship of Legends and the 2026 ACC Men’s Premier Cup.
